Food

What guests order

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Brunch

Shakshuka, poached eggs with avocado, yoghurt with granola. One guest calls it the best shakshuka in Cyprus.

Bowls and lunch

Vegan bowls, falafel and fresh salads. Guests mention veggie and vegan options.

Cakes

Carrot cake, brownies and olive cake. A reviewer writes there is always a lovely dessert.

Coffee and lemonade

Coffee from a proper espresso machine and homemade lemonade. Cheese pie to take away.

Lunch in the garden

Book ahead

A fresh approach

Written on the sign at ZĖST. A casual place for healthy brunch and lunch in central Nicosia, open Monday to Saturday from 8:00 to 15:30.

What guests say

Three of 103 Google reviews, 77 of them with five stars.

“The best Shakshuka in Cyprus. All dishes and salads are fresh. Highly recommended”

Google review
“Lovely cafe. Nice staff. Great coffee (great espresso machine), good food (we had shatshuka, poached eggs and avocado, and yoghurt and granola). If nearby give it a go. Veggie and vegan options. Delicious cheese pie to takeaway!”

Google review
“Had a wonderful lunch in the garden of Zest today. Wholesome, tasty and very good value for money. Portions were good. I recommend and will definitely visit again. We had to book as it gets quite busy over lunch.”
